question: Pankaj can do one-fifth of a piece of work in 6 days and Jagath can do one-fourth of the same work in 8 days. Find the number of days taken to complete the work if both work together. (Round the answer to one decimal place.)
solution:
**Given:**

Pankaj can do one-fifth of a piece of work in 6 days.

Jagath can do one-fourth of the same work in 8 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done by Pankaj in 1 day = 1/(5×6)

Work done by Jagath in 1 day = 1/(4×8)

Total work done by both in 1 day = (Work done by Pankaj in 1 day) + (Work done by Jagath in 1 day)
